WELCOME TO
NORTHERN RAIL
- TRAINCAR INN -
a One-of-a-Kind Experience
Made up of genuine train boxcars, the Northern Rail Traincar Inn offers a unique experience for our guests, who come from all over the world to stay in our Boxcars!
We are on Peter Greenberg's list of the " Worlds 10 Most Unusual Hotels !"
Image may be subject to copyright
Authentic Train Boxcars
Northern Rail features 15 rooms in real train boxcars that have been renovated with modern day amenities.
Each room is one of several themes:
Victorian,
Oriental,
Safari,
Fishing,
Lighthouse,
Bear & Moose.
Our boxcar accommodations are connected by a charming enclosed hallway that is reminiscent of an old fashioned train station platform.
All of our guests have experienced our distinctive accommodations. Enjoy the peaceful quiet of our boxcars while you get to know the many people visiting here. Get a virtual tour of our Inn here .
EASY ACCESS TO THE OUTDOORS
Our Traincar Inn is nestled in the wilderness. Spring, summer, fall or winter, the natural beauty and peaceful serenity of the area combine for a wonderful place for you to stay on the North Shore for a great getaway!
At 35 minutes from Duluth, guests enjoy quick, convenient access to all of the North Shore's amazing activities , including:
Superior Hiking Trail,
State Snowmobile Trails,
Ski Trails,
Gooseberry Falls,
Split Rock Lighthouse
Gitchi-Gami State Bicycle Trail
and much more!
We are just three miles north of Two Harbors, Minnesota, near the intersection of Hwy 61 and County Hwy 3.

INTERNATIONAL GUESTS
Northern Rail has welcomed thousands of guests and visitors, some from all over the world .
We have visitors from as near as our backyard and as far away as:
* Australia
* Canada
* Dubai (UAE)
* England
* Germany
* Ireland
* Japan
* Netherlands
* New Zealand
* Poland
* Russia
* Scotland
* South Africa
* Switzerland
The depot-style main building serves as our guest relations and breakfast area, as well as a place for all guests to play games or sit by the fireplace with a good book!
All Aboard!
A getaway unlike any other - a truly unique, year-round lodging experience awaits you!

BOXCAR ACCOMMODATIONS
Northern Rail is open year-round (except for April) with a unique setting for you to enjoy the special beauty of each season in Northern Minnesota. Take in views of the rugged Northwoods where we are treated to regular visits from deer, birds, squirrels and our special woodpecker friends! If you are really lucky you might get a glimpse of other impressive creatures of the North Shore like a bear, an eagle, a moose or even a wolf!
Accommodations consist of 11 welcoming bed & bath guest rooms and 3 full car suites in authentic train boxcars. Each room is one of several themes - Victorian, Oriental, Safari, Lighthouse, Fishing, Bear (not bare!) and Moose.
Northern Rail is handicap accessible and is a smoke-free, pet-free environment. All of our rooms have views of the rugged wilderness and tranquil serenity of the Northwoods!
We provide our guests with a continental breakfast, a lending library of games, toys and even DVD's (all rooms have 40" Smart TV's with a separate DVD player). All rooms have mini fridges. There is a microwave available in the lobby. We have snowshoes available in the winter for our guests to use. For those guests who wish to use their laptop computer or phones to keep in touch with home or work we have WiFi available in each room and the lobby.
We have two rate seasons - Summer and Winter. Summer Rate Season starts the Friday of Memorial Day weekend and runs through Mid-October (MEA weekend). Winter Rate Season starts Mid-October (Sunday of MEA weekend) and runs through the Thursday before Memorial Day weekend.
Rates are for 2 adults. Children 12 and under stay free! (Extra Guests ages 13 and up are $10 per night).
Our room rates are the same 7 days a week ( no higher weekend or holiday rates ). Any coupons, specials or discounts are available Sunday thru Thursday only except for the annual "January Customer Appreciation Special".
